title: Jude and the Parish
author: Vesper Coldharbour
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
